headline: PIT @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 3.86 at ATL 4.31, with a projected total of 8.17. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: PIT moved +0.44 runs while ATL moved +0.84, changing the projected margin by -0.40 runs. The projected total climbed +1.27, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Braxton Ashcraft has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nick Gonzales, Michael Harris II, Matt Olson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Dominic Smith, Eli White because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
